hook: Report a panel discussion fairly by catching each speaker's position together with the condition or concession that limits it.
intro: A panel discussion on digital schools, heard once: two positions (Herr Lang: tablets could enrich lessons, provided teachers are trained — sofern; Frau Roth: concentration suffers, and screen reading is more superficial), an objection and a concession on each side, a moderator who closes with a summary in reported speech, and a point of agreement. In a panel or radio discussion the skill is holding each speaker's position with its condition or qualification — 'sofern die Lehrkräfte geschult seien' is part of Lang's view, and missing that condition means misreporting him — and hearing the reported forms (Konjunktiv I) that the moderator uses to summarise. Note the discussion verbs: argumentieren, dagegenhalten (counter), einwenden (object), einräumen (concede), sich einig sein.
tips[0].title: Position + condition
tips[0].text: Herr Lang: Tablets könnten den Unterricht bereichern, sofern die Lehrkräfte gut geschult seien. The sofern-clause is half his position; a statement 'Lang ist uneingeschränkt für Tablets' would be false.
tips[0].check.why: The sofern-clause is half of his position: his support depends on that condition.
tips[1].title: Discussion verbs mark the moves
tips[1].text: argumentieren (argue), dagegenhalten (counter), einwenden (object), einräumen (concede), betonen (stress), zustimmen (agree), sich einig sein (agree jointly). 'Was kritisiert Frau Roth?' → the sentence after 'hält dagegen'.
tips[1].check.why: einräumen means to concede: she grants the other side's point, usually before an aber.
tips[2].title: The agreement is the last move
tips[2].text: Beide sind sich einig, dass … / Einigkeit besteht darin, dass … — the moderator's closing summary; always a question.
tips[2].check.why: Einigkeit besteht darin, dass … introduces what everyone agrees on, which usually comes last.
remember[0]: Each position with its sofern / aber.
remember[1]: dagegenhalten, einwenden, einräumen, sich einig sein: the discussion's verbs.
exam: Panel discussions where you attribute statements to speakers are a standard listening text in the C1 exam — and on the radio.
tips[0].check.q: An expert says: „Homeoffice steigert die Produktivität, sofern die Technik zuverlässig funktioniert.“ Which summary is accurate?
tips[0].check.options[0]: He supports home office if the technology is reliable.
tips[0].check.options[1]: He supports home office without reservation.
tips[0].check.answer: He supports home office if the technology is reliable.
tips[1].check.q: „Frau Berg räumt ein, dass die Kosten hoch sind.“ What is Frau Berg doing?
tips[2].check.q: At the end the moderator says: „Einigkeit besteht darin, dass Schulen mehr Personal brauchen.“ What is this?
tips[2].check.options[0]: the point both sides agree on
tips[2].check.options[2]: a new question for the panel
tips[2].check.answer: the point both sides agree on
